newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAKIA SETS TENDER FOR LOAN, INFRASTRUCTURE.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAKIA SETS TENDER FOR LOAN, INFRASTRUCTURE.

text.p: Slovakia has set a tender for a $250 million international loan to boost basic capital of the planned state-run Exim bank and help finance infrastructure projects, the daily Narodna Obroda reported on Friday.
"The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) has already contacted some foreign banks and the (initial) offers we are getting are very favourable," the daily quoted NBS Vice-governor Marian Jusko as saying.
Around one-third of the credit should be used to boost the basic capital of the planned Export-Import bank, expected to begin operations this summer, Jusko said.
The rest of the funds should help finance unspecified infrastructrure projects which were originally planned to be covered by the state budget.
No further details on the loan were disclosed and NBS officials, including Jusko himself, were not immediately available for comment.
